beats.text: A second-hand book. ₹40. Abids Sunday market.
Someone had written in the margins. Funny notes. Sad ones.
On the last page: "If you're reading this, write back."
So she did. And left the book back at the same stall.
Six months later, the book returned. Two new pages of handwriting.
beats.small: Some friendships start in the margins.

end.text: Do you write in your books?
